proof_body:
by
  intro b N d hb hN
  have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hbr : (1 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hb
  rw [Nat.length_digits b N hb hN0, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff,
    Nat.log_eq_iff (Or.inr ⟨hb, hN0⟩)]
  rw [Real.le_logb_iff_rpow_le hbr hNr, Real.logb_lt_iff_lt_rpow hbr hNr]
  have e1 : (b : ℝ) ^ (d : ℝ) = ((b ^ d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_natCast]; norm_cast
  have e2 : (b : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) + 1) = ((b ^ (d + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have : ((d : ℝ) + 1) = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [this, Real.rpow_natCast]; norm_cast
  rw [e1, e2, Nat.cast_le, Nat.cast_lt]
target_source: ∀ (b N d : ℕ), 1 < b → 1 ≤ N → ((Nat.digits b N).length = d + 1 ↔ (d : ℝ) ≤ Real.logb b (N : ℝ) ∧ Real.logb b (N : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) + 1)
